differences.what: massing: the pair seen from the north-east, its front, 1700's north wall and the mansard over both
differences.how: T-3211: the same K01 pair; corners and cornice line render on the print's within a few pixels

differences.what: 1700's north end wall carried up past the mansard's curb
differences.how: T-3211: K05's side parapet on 1700's north wall, coped about 0.6 m over the curb

differences.what: the eight upper windows, the eight arched principal windows' places and the balconettes
differences.how: T-3211: as built from Chicagology's photograph; they render on this print's within about 5 px T-3212: the arched lights now run down behind the balconettes to a sill about 1.45 m over grade.

differences.what: both porches, 1706's at the south end and 1700's at the north, their columns, entablatures and balcony railings
differences.how: T-3211: as built from the two cameras' triangulation; the balcony railings render on the print's lines

T-3211: the triangulated places render about 20-45 px off this print's, the other way from Chicagology's: the two camera fits disagree about the dormers' depth by about half a metre T-3297: both lights of each dormer's pair open (only the first had been cut through its face), built 1.45 m wide

differences.what: the large chimney at the party line with a fret panel over the deck
differences.how: T-3211: the party wall's parapet and a stack beside it stand there; the fret panel is not built

T-3211: the two pictures disagree about the fences (Chicagology shows 1700's front open), and the front boundaries are T-3205's T-3212: 1700's railing is now built from its gateway at the foot of its flight north to the lot line, on its curb, the gates on dark iron posts standing open; the print's railing runs on past the lot line before the next lot, which is that lot's to build. The gateway's place along the street line is not read through this camera (fitted on the front alone; see the 1901 record).

differences.what: ornament: keys, carving, dentils, capitals, the fret
differences.how: T-3211: as in Chicagology's view, under a foot at this distance T-3297: the upper lights' stone keys are built now (0.28-0.34 m across, 0.5 m high), and each renders over its light as the print shows it

T-3244: the brick prints darker than the house's own slate and (here) at 0.30-0.38 of the porches' white paint: a red brick, laid in K03's red-brown panel; the porches, cornice, dormers and sash print white with the columns, and are painted white (linear 0.86, 0.85, 0.80) where they had been beige stone, a light grey-beige and the kit's dark green (docs/RESEARCH/colour-1700-block-T-3244/README.md)

differences.what: the pair's walks: a flagged walk from each flight's foot to the public walk through open gates

the dormers' pediments: the photograph's carry a moulded raking cornice over a returned entablature, the face framed by pilasters either side of the paired sash; the build's are plain painted gables over a plain surround
differences.how: T-3297: ornament under a foot, as the arched heads' carving and the porch capitals are here: each dormer's pediment stands where the photograph's does, its moulding and pilasters not cut; K10's dormer pediment cornice (T-2326) dresses only a K01 front dormer, not the mansard's lower-face ones. Noted on the owner's report of the dormers (2026-11-01) and left for his word

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236). A ticket whose ## Image gate names this building does not close while it is not "matches" (tools/image_gate.mjs).
